firebase-config.author: tanyagoyan-boop
firebase-config.message:
Fixes #5439: Fix ConcurrentModificationException  (#8686)

### Problem
The listeners in `ConfigRealtimeHandler` are stored in a
`LinkedHashSet`. If a listener calls `remove()` inside its own
`onError`, `ConfigRealtimeHttpClient.propagateErrors` throws a
`ConcurrentModificationException` while looping over the set. On the
main thread (Activity `onResume` → `setBackgroundState(false)` →
`makeRealtimeHttpConnection`), the app crashes with "Unable to resume
activity".

### Fix
Store the listeners in a `CopyOnWriteArraySet`. Loops then run over a
snapshot of the set, so a listener can remove itself mid-loop without
breaking it.

### Testing
- Added `ConfigRealtimeHandlerTest`: listener A removes itself in
`onError`, and the test checks that listener B is still notified. It
fails before the fix and passes after.
With LinkedHashSet : https://screenshot-v2.corp.google.com/43mnvd33td1bg
With CopyOnWriteArraySet :
https://screenshot-v2.corp.google.com/4sl8fqrodc3h8
- Manual repro in the Remote Config quickstart, using a local SDK build
with retries lowered to 1 and the Realtime API disabled:
  - Before the fix, : 


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a33fa3d4-6798-4eb6-8f61-db800f118835


- After the fix, both listeners received `onError` and there was no
crash.
  


https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/37514025-3de4-4339-b62b-cb408a6ac029

firebase-dataconnect.author: Denver Coneybeare
firebase-dataconnect.message:
dataconnect(fix): add proguard rules to prevent minification of GeneratedMessageLite (#8698) This PR adds consumer ProGuard rules to `firebase-dataconnect` to prevent minification of classes extending `com.google.protobuf.GeneratedMessageLite`, fixing `NoSuchFieldException` crashes at runtime when executing queries or mutations in apps with R8/ProGuard optimizations enabled. This change is an adaptation of the same fix applied to `firebase-perf` in #8697. This regression was introduced in `firebase-dataconnect` version `18.0.0` (Firebase BoM version `35.0.0`, released October 07, 2026) by #8580 (the gRPC upgrade to `1.84.0`), which removed the transitive dependency on `protolite-well-known-types` and the consumer ProGuard rules that it exported. Without those rules, R8/ProGuard obfuscates fields on `GeneratedMessageLite` subclasses that `protobuf-javalite` accesses via reflection, resulting in runtime exceptions such as: ``` java.lang.RuntimeException: Field kind_ for o42 not found. Known fields are [public byte o42.e, public java.lang.Object o42.f, public static final o42 o42.g, public static volatile nb0 o42.h] at e21.F(r8-map-id-1bddf604103a63afe053c8136fba1566463c4190837d3f6c7eba12c97a5f4b9b:64) ... Caused by: java.lang.NoSuchFieldException: No field kind_ in class Lo42; (declaration of 'o42') at java.lang.Class.getDeclaredField(Native Method) ... ``` ### Highlights * **Consumer ProGuard Rules for Protobuf Lite**: Added `proguard-rules.pro` with `-keepclassmembers` for subclasses of `com.google.protobuf.GeneratedMessageLite` to work around [protocolbuffers/protobuf#6463](https://github.com/protocolbuffers/protobuf/issues/6463#issuecomment-553183215) and configured `firebase-dataconnect` to export these consumer ProGuard rules. * **Regression Fix**: Restores the consumer ProGuard rules that were previously provided transitively by `protolite-well-known-types` prior to the gRPC `1.84.0` upgrade in #8580, matching the fix made for `firebase-perf` in #8697.
Changelog * **CHANGELOG.md** * Added a `[fixed]` entry under `Unreleased` noting that `NoSuchFieldException` is no longer thrown by query and mutation executions when R8/ProGuard optimizations are enabled. * **firebase-dataconnect.gradle.kts** * Added `consumerProguardFiles("proguard-rules.pro")` to `defaultConfig` in the `android` block. * **proguard-rules.pro** * New file containing a `-keepclassmembers` ProGuard rule preserving fields of classes extending `com.google.protobuf.GeneratedMessageLite`.
--------- Co-authored-by: Rodrigo Lazo

firebase-dataconnect.message:
dataconnect(change): AnyValue.kt: disambiguate [serializer] kdoc links (#8649)

This PR fixes ambiguous `[serializer]` KDoc references in `AnyValue.kt`
so that they render properly as hyperlinks in the generated HTML
documentation. It replaces the unqualified `[serializer]` KDoc links
with fully qualified `[kotlinx.serialization.serializer]` links and
removes the unused `AnyValue.Companion.serializer` import that caused
the ambiguity.

firebase-messaging.author: Vick Wang
firebase-messaging.message:
Handle non-retryable errors in TopicsSubscriber (#8662)

When performTopicOperation() throws a non-retryable IOException (such as
HTTP 400 Bad Request), syncTopics() previously aborted without removing
the failed operation from TopicsStore or completing its pending
TaskCompletionSource. This caused the caller's Task<Void> to hang
indefinitely and blocked all subsequent topic operations in the
persistent queue.

- Catch non-retryable IOExceptions per operation in syncTopics(), remove
the failed operation from TopicsStore, fail the corresponding
TaskCompletionSource with the exception, and continue syncing remaining
queued operations.

- Add unit tests in TopicsSubscriberRoboTest covering non-retryable
subscribe/unsubscribe failures and multi-operation queue progression.

Fixes https://github.com/firebase/firebase-android-sdk/issues/8620

firebase-messaging.author: Vick Wang
firebase-messaging.message:
URL-encode topic name in TopicSubscriptionClient (#8658)

URL-encode the topic name in TopicSubscriptionClient when constructing
the topicSubscriptions URL path.

- Use Uri.encode(topic) so percent characters (%) in valid topic names
are encoded as %25 while preserving RFC 3986 unreserved characters (-,
_, ., ~).

- Add unit tests in TopicSubscriptionClientRoboTest covering URL
encoding for subscribe and unsubscribe requests.

Fixes https://github.com/firebase/firebase-android-sdk/issues/8620

ai-logic/firebase-ai.author: Vinay Guthal
ai-logic/firebase-ai.message:
Add thinking mode for ai logic hybrid (#8678)

Adds support for thinking mode (`enableThinking`) when generating
content using on-device and hybrid inference modes.

### Summary of Changes
- **`firebase-ai-ondevice-interop`**:
  - Added `enableThinking: Boolean?` to `GenerateContentRequest`.
- Added `thoughtProcess: List<Candidate>` to `GenerateContentResponse`.
  - Added `isThinkingModeAvailable(): Boolean` to `GenerativeModel`.
  - Updated `api.txt`.
- **`firebase-ai-ondevice`**:
- Implemented `GenerativeModelImpl.isThinkingModeAvailable()` delegating
to ML Kit's `GenerativeModel.isThinkingModeAvailable()`.
- Updated `Converters.kt` to pass `enableThinking` to the ML Kit request
and map `thoughtProcess` candidates to the interop
`GenerateContentResponse`.
- **`firebase-ai`**:
- Added `enableThinking: Boolean? = null` to `OnDeviceConfig` and
updated `api.txt`.
- Updated `OnDeviceGenerativeModelProvider` to check
`onDeviceModel.isThinkingModeAvailable()` when `enableThinking == true`
(throwing `FirebaseAIOnDeviceNotAvailableException` so
`PREFER_ON_DEVICE` falls back to cloud when unsupported) and forward
`enableThinking` to the on-device request.
- Updated `Candidate` and `OnDeviceGenerativeModelProvider` response
mapping to convert interop `thoughtProcess` candidates into `TextPart`
entries with `isThought = true` (populating
`GenerateContentResponse.thoughtSummary` for both unary and streaming
responses).
- **Tests & Changelogs**: Added unit tests in `ConvertersTest`,
`GenerativeModelImplTest`, and `OnDeviceGenerativeModelProviderTests`,
and updated `CHANGELOG.md` across all three modules.


Tested at https://github.com/firebase/quickstart-android/pull/2848

---------

Co-authored-by: gemini-code-assist[bot] <176961590+gemini-code-assist[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

ai-logic/firebase-ai.author: Vinay Guthal
ai-logic/firebase-ai.message:
Add support for system instructions in the ondevice sdk. (#8663)

Adds support for `systemInstruction` when generating content using
on-device and hybrid inference modes.

### Summary of Changes
- **`firebase-ai-ondevice-interop`**: Added an optional
`systemInstruction: TextPart?` property to `GenerateContentRequest` and
updated `api.txt`.
- **`firebase-ai-ondevice`**: Updated `GenerateContentRequest.toMlKit()`
in `Converters.kt` to convert the interop `TextPart` into an ML Kit
`SystemInstruction`.
- **`firebase-ai`**:
- Passed `systemInstruction` from `GenerativeModel.Builder` to
`OnDeviceGenerativeModelProvider`.
- Updated `OnDeviceGenerativeModelProvider` to validate that
`systemInstruction` contains only text parts (throwing
`FirebaseAIOnDeviceInvalidRequestException` for non-text parts),
concatenate multiple `TextPart` instances with a newline, and attach it
to the on-device request.
- **Tests & Changelogs**: Added unit tests in `ConvertersTest`,
`GenerativeModelBuilderTests`, and
`OnDeviceGenerativeModelProviderTests`, and updated `CHANGELOG.md`
across all three modules.


Tested updating the quickstart app to add testing functionality for
system instruction at
https://github.com/firebase/quickstart-android/pull/2846
